assets.caption: T-10 Thermowell flanged thermowell connection detail — NPS 3/4 & UP, three installation configurations
assets.notes: Engineering drawing showing three configurations of T-10 thermowell flanged connection: top-left (horizontal with reducer, 300 mm / (12) MIN dimension), top-right (vertical with butt weld pipe), and bottom (horizontal stub end configuration for NPS 6 line size & up). Labels include NPS 1-1/2 lap joint flange, NPS 1-1/2 lap joint stub end, NPS 1-1/2 butt weld pipet, NPS 3/4 thru NPS 4 line size, line size x NPS 6 swage/reducer, instr piping, field make up.
